name: Weather
description: Forecasts, official alerts and specialized weather data, with source attribution.
abilities: Forecasts reuse NWS, MET Norway and DWD
Recent US station observations and active alerts
Licensed global history, model forecasts, marine waves and air quality when configured
permissions: Sends requested locations to weather providers
Advanced Open-Meteo products require a licensed key and explicit operator enablement

changes.notes: Official deferred tools, on by default. Load only when needed; turn off in the Store.
